survivorship.name: source_trust_ranking
survivorship.definition: Locked tier order (PR #131, Alicia+Luis 2026-06-17): 1) DMS = ground truth (signed transactional record — wins name/address/vehicle ownership); 2) CRM = operational (wins engagement prefs, sales-rep relationship, lead provenance); 3) Email engagement / Twilio (wins channel-state: subscribed/unsubscribed, last engaged); 4) Third-party enrichment (Recall Masters/BlackBook — lowest trust on identity, high trust on data they own).

survivorship.name: per_field_matrix
survivorship.definition: Per-field winning source: name/mailing address/vehicle ownership -> DMS; engagement prefs/sales-rep/lead provenance -> CRM; channel state -> Email/Twilio; recalls/valuation/enrichment-owned facts -> third-party.

survivorship.name: recency_tiebreak
survivorship.definition: Most recent observation wins within a trust tier.

survivorship.name: non_destruction
survivorship.definition: Per-element provenance retained alongside the surviving value; no source permanently overridden — losing values remain in entity history (bitemporal) for audit and re-resolution.

survivorship.name: null_nonnull_preference
survivorship.definition: A non-null lower-trust value beats a null/blank higher-trust value for the same field (cross-tier exception to the trust ladder; never let a higher-trust NULL win). Confirmed at v1.0 review (Alicia + Luis, 2026-06-21).

survivorship.name: curation_supremacy
survivorship.definition: An operator-confirmed (curation-queue) value is the HIGHEST trust — above DMS — and is not overwritten by a subsequent automated feed. Confirmed at v1.0 review (Alicia + Luis, 2026-06-21).

survivorship.name: confidence_gating
survivorship.definition: A value's contribution is gated/weighted by the confidence of the identity link that brought its record in — a low-confidence heuristic match must not override a high-confidence record (ties to confidence_bands). Confirmed at v1.0 review (Alicia + Luis, 2026-06-21).

survivorship.name: channel_state_recency_override
survivorship.definition: For consent / channel-state fields, the MOST RECENT observation wins regardless of trust tier (a fresh unsubscribe from any channel beats a stale DMS opt-in); on conflict, MOST RESTRICTIVE wins. Confirmed at v1.0 review (Alicia + Luis, 2026-06-21).

survivorship.name: multi_valued_retention
survivorship.definition: For multi-valued fields (contact points, addresses, vehicles — they are edges, not single columns) survivorship is NOT pick-one-winner: all values are retained, a PRIMARY is selected by trust+recency, and nothing is discarded. Confirmed at v1.0 review (Alicia + Luis, 2026-06-21).

survivorship.name: erasure_no_resurrect
survivorship.definition: A deleted / tombstoned value must not resurrect from a lower-trust source on the next ingest — erasure is durable across re-resolution. Confirmed at v1.0 review (Alicia + Luis, 2026-06-21).

survivorship.name: cross_tenant_scope
survivorship.definition: Survivorship scope: the DAS-global golden record vs dealer-isolated views — for a consumer shared across dealers, define whose DMS wins (and which fields stay tenant-isolated). Architectural; likely Phase-1. Confirmed at v1.0 review (Alicia + Luis, 2026-06-21).

provenance_model.name: bitemporal_observation_layer
provenance_model.definition: Locked (PR #131, A3): valid-time (valid_from/valid_to = true-in-world) + system-time (recorded_at/superseded_at = when CDP learned/superseded). Bitemporality applies to the observation layer only (reference tables out of scope). The golden-record entities' valid_from/valid_to realize this; system-time uses recorded_at/superseded_at (was 'observed_at').

provenance_model.name: tstzrange_gist_nonoverlap
provenance_model.definition: Temporal columns modeled as tstzrange with a GiST exclusion constraint — a given (entity, attribute) cannot have overlapping valid-time intervals (enforced, not conventional).

provenance_model.name: append_only_supersede
provenance_model.definition: No updates/deletes of observations; corrections are new rows that supersede prior (superseded_at set on the old row).

provenance_model.name: as_of_is_golden_evolution
provenance_model.definition: As-of time-travel over this layer IS the golden-record evolution view: the surviving value at any (valid-time, system-time) reconstructs what the record was and what the CDP believed at that moment.

provenance_model.name: per_fact_provenance
provenance_model.definition: Every edge/attribute carries contributing tenant + source + method + confidence + event_id; required at ingest.

confidence_bands.name: high_auto_merge
confidence_bands.definition: Single deterministic key match -> auto-merge. Configurable per-tenant; Phase 1 conservative (queue on doubt).

confidence_bands.name: medium_queue
confidence_bands.definition: Heuristic + multiple candidates -> conflict/curation queue for operator decision.

confidence_bands.name: low_new_identity
confidence_bands.definition: Nothing above threshold -> mint a new identity; revisit as more evidence arrives.

curation_queue.name: routing
curation_queue.definition: Medium-confidence/conflicting matches route here with full evidence + provenance carriage and priority/aging.

curation_queue.name: capacity
curation_queue.definition: Phase-1 manual operator SLAs + configurable thresholds; 2-4 weeks measurement sets headcount. Phase-2 ML fills with confidence-scored recommendations (3-5x absorption).

curation_queue.name: outcome
curation_queue.definition: Operator decisions recorded to merge_history and captured as ML training labels.

merge_split_machinery.name: reversibility
merge_split_machinery.definition: Merges/splits are reversible; on reverse, identity_link/contact_point/address states reattach bitemporally.

merge_split_machinery.name: audit
merge_split_machinery.definition: Every merge/split records who/when/why + evidence; reprocessing is idempotent.

household_resolution.name: detection
household_resolution.definition: Household formed from canonical address + >=1 of shared phone / surname / co-occurring service history. Provisional until curation; recomputable, allowed to be wrong.

household_resolution.name: phase_boundary
household_resolution.definition: Phase-1 marks household membership; household lifecycle events deferred to Phase 2.
